segments.text:
He hath often a desire to be like the children of God in happinesse, and to be saued: not because he hath any loue to the kingdom of God, but because he is afraid of hell. As Balaam ouerpressed with the feare of Gods iudgement, praied thus:
Oh that my soule might die the death of the righteous, and that my last end might be like his.
